label: s2_side01_0200_sister_01
text: Hey, you guys![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_02
text: Are you really going home already? No one\nwould mind if you stayed longer.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_select_01
text: I’ll come back again!

label: s2_side01_0200_select_02
text: Yep, time to head home!

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_03
text: Yeah... You’d better![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_04
text: Ugh, what kind of a response is that?\c\nThis is where you’re supposed to say you’ll miss\nus or that you’ll visit again soon or something![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_01
text: Hey, uh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]? Everyone...?\c\nThank you all so much for coming![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_friend_01
text: Nah, we should be the ones thanking you for\nshowing us such a good time! And the food, man!\r\nEverything we ate here was so good![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0200_botan_01
text: The festival was a lot of fun too! I even got to\nbuy a Veevee mask—what more could you want?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_02
text: Heh... Well, good! I’m glad you liked it here.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_rival_01
text: Time really flew by! Just goes to show how much\nfun we were having, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0200_rival_02
text: Wish I could’ve fit in more battles against both\nof you, though...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_05
text: Are you kidding me?! You battled each of us\na dozen times or more![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_botan_02
text: Welcome to the Nemona Survivors Club...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_03
text: I really am happy I got to meet you all.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_04
text: I’ve been thinking about it a lot, and...I’m gonna\ngive Blueberry Academy another shot.\c\nI’m really gonna go for it this time![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_select_03
text: Do your best!

label: s2_side01_0200_select_04
text: You’ve got this!

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_06
text: Aw, I guess that means my vacation’s over too...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_07
text: Time for me to head back to school too, then![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_06
text: Hey, Sis... Thanks for, like, comin’ with me here\nand everything![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_friend_02
text: This has been great, seriously... I’m real glad I\ngot to come here and meet you all![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0200_friend_03
text: And, Kieran... I really am sorry for trying to flex\non you the way I did when I first got here.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_07
text: Huh? Were you? I didn’t even notice...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_08
text: Don’t worry about it, Arven. Feel free to flex on\nKiki as much as you like. I’ll allow it.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_botan_03
text: Wow... Looks like Carmine’s another one with a\nbig personality, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0200_brother_08
text: Yeah. Sorry about her.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_09
text: Excuse me?! Who do you think you’re\napologizing for?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_sister_10
text: And, YOU guys! What do you mean by\n“big personality”?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: s2_side01_0200_rival_npc
text: Mochi-mochi MATCH!\c\nI really don’t remember much of that night,\nbut it’s still fun to say![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0200_friend_npc
text: Our trip to Kitakami was the best! I’m glad\nI could go together with all my buds.\c\nThanks again for inviting us along![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0200_botan_npc
text: That was a lot of outdoor time. Gotta hole up\nindoors for a bit to balance it out.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
